{{Quote|Looks like they got Progga, too.''"<br />"''I doubt it. His ship's big enough to have cap drains and other stuff to protect him from tricks like this.|[[Jorj Car'das]], and Qennto, both crew members of the ''Bargain Hunter'', after the pair of ships are hit by Connor nets|<ref name="OF" />}}
[[Progga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] and [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]], owned a '''starship''' by the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]]. He used the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] to attempt to board the ''[[Bargain Hunter]]'', a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler's]] ship, in that year to take its cargo. However, the ''Bargain Hunter'' led Progga and his ship on an [[Skirmish between Progga and the Bargain Hunter|extended chase]], which left them in a [[Unidentified Unknown Regions star system (skirmish between Progga and Picket Force Two)|star system]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. There, both parties were confronted by [[Picket Force Two/Legends|Picket Force Two]] of the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]] [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Force|Expansionary Fleet]], and Progga and his ship were [[Skirmish between Progga and Picket Force Two|destroyed]] after Progga engaged the newcomers.

==Description==
[[Progga]]'s [[Starship/Legends|starship]] was equipped with [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] as armaments, and had a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] installed. The vessel was large enough to have [[cap drain]]s and other measures to protect the vessel from [[Electromagnetic pulse/Legends|electromagnetic pulses]] that were designed to knock out the ships' systems.<ref name="OF" /> The ship was crewed by multiple beings.<ref name="Progga">{{CSWECite|III||Progga the Hutt}}</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|Maybe there were survivors from Progga's crew.''"<br />"''I doubt it. You saw what the ship looked like. The thing's peeled open like a ration bar.|[[Maris Ferasi]], a crew member of the ''Bargain Hunter'', and Qennto, on the fate of Progga's ship|<ref name="OF" />}}
Progga, a minor [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]]<ref name="Progga" /> and [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]], owned the starship<ref name="OF" /> by [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date" /> he attempted to [[Skirmish between Progga and the Bargain Hunter|hijack]] a cargo of [[firegem]]s and [[Hair/Legends|furs]] that was being carried by the ''[[Bargain Hunter]]'', a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] ship [[Captain/Legends|captained]] by [[Dubrak Qennto]]. Qennto was transporting the cargo to [[Drixo]], a Hutt rival of Progga, on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Comra/Legends|Comra]]. Although Progga's ship fired upon the ''Bargain Hunter'' with its armaments, the latter ship jumped to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], leaving Progga and his ship to pursue the smugglers. Progga and his vessel managed to follow the ''Baragain Hunter''{{'s}} course, and attacked them again once they came back to [[Realspace/Legends|realspace]]. The ''Bargain Hunter''{{'s}} crew, realizing that they were still being chased, made another jump to hyperspace, and Progga had his ship's crew follow the smugglers' vector once more.<ref name="OF" />

[[File:Outboundthrawn.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Mitth'raw'nuruodo's ''Springhawk'' attacked Progga's ship.]]
Both starships traveled for four [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]], and arrived in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] after passing through the regions of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. Upon coming out of hyperspace, Progga had the starship go to the nearest [[Unidentified Unknown Regions star system (skirmish between Progga and Picket Force Two)|star system]] after they tracked the ''Bargain Hunter'' there. Because the star system was in the middle of nowhere, the starship's captain thought that Qennto had a hidden smuggler's base there, though in fact the ''Bargain Hunter'' had arrived in the Unknown Regions and that particular system by accident after the crew had taken a blind hyperspace jump. However, as Progga [[Comlink/Legends|commed]] the other ship and demanded to know where the base was, both ships were attacked with [[Conner net]]s, which released electromagnetic pulses.<ref name="OF" />

The ''Bargain Hunter''{{'s}} systems were knocked out, but since Progga's starship was designed to be able to resist these, it stayed operational.<ref name="OF" /> Progga had his starship's crew engage the attackers,<ref name="Progga" /> who were elements of the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]] [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Force|Expansionary Fleet]] known as [[Picket Force Two/Legends|Picket Force Two]], which was led by the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] ''[[Springhawk/Legends|Springhawk]]'' and its [[Commander/Legends|commander]], [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]]. Although Progga's starship managed to target the ''Springhawk'' with its fire, Progga and his ship were both destroyed after six [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]] of combat with the larger Chiss force, leaving the ship's hull peeled open.<ref name="OF" />

==Commander's and crew==
The captain of the vessel was Progga, who sometimes jumped to conclusions and acted rash, such as when he engaged the Chiss, who were much more heavily armed. This course of action led to the ship's destruction, and the deaths of the entire crew and Progga.<ref name="OF" />

==Behind the scenes==
Progga's starship first appeared in [[2006]]'s [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']], by [[Timothy Zahn]].<ref name="OF" />
